svg.aria-label: Three node classes left to right: expert and pilot nodes decide and collect, country sequencing nodes generate and process, applied nodes turn data into action; samples and priorities flow right, genomes and baselines flow right, management questions return
svg.title: Three node classes
svg.text: Three node classes — decide + collect, generate + process, where data becomes action
Every participant in the Western Pacific Marine Genomics Network sits in exactly one of these three classes.
